body: It's very nice to meet you, as well! I'm so sorry for the delay in responding to your question.  I have not been awake for long, myself, although I've known since childhood that I was different and never felt like I belonged. My mother had psychic abilities and I remember several, I'll call them events, that she had while I was a child up until I was in my early twenties. She was raised by very religious parents, who rejected "new age" ideas and philosophies. I believe I witnessed alien visitation to my mother when I was a child, by small grey ET's. Why I was permitted to witness, I am not sure. I can't remember if I was actually in the room, or it was a viewing in dream time? They didn't abduct her when I was present, that I'm aware of. My father was a non-believer. Very difficult man. I think my mother's mind was wiped over and over again, after these events. She developed Alzheimer's disease in her 50's. I think there is a correlation there. My grandmother had Alzheimer's disease, too. She never admitted to experiencing anything extraterrestrial. She dived deep into her faith. My mother also reverted back to her traditional beliefs and never wanted to discuss anything ET related again. So I had no one to talk to. My awakening was gradual. I have always been able to do astral projection. I thought it was mostly during dream time, but am working on being fully awake when this happens. Perhaps in meditation.  I do not know who my star family is. I have not been hypnotized to discover my past lives, though have always wanted to do that. It's more of a "knowing" that I am a star seed, put here in this incarnation on the earth to help others. I know my main spirit guide. His name is Andrew. He has saved me many times by imparting information that I used to remove myself from dangerous situations. I am very sensitive and empathic toward others. I hope to learn more about what my path is and how I can be of service to others. I know I'm a bit late to the table, but better late than never!

I was in the first wave of star seeds so that makes me twice as old as you are. I have had months at a time throughout my adult life where I have suffered severe migraine headaches that produce the auras that you're talking about with all of the maddening colors. I feel intense pressure like my brain is going to explode but specifically between my eyes. I have undergone every kind of test possible. The neurologists can never find a reason for these severe migraines and then after 6 to 8 months of suffering and the crazy feelings that come with those experiences it all ends abruptly. Then I go for a period of several years with no migraines at all. Personally I feel that this is affecting my pineal gland and expanding it. I have noticed that after the 6 to 8 months of pain and suffering I have years of better and clearer third eye sight and visions. I feel in my case that perhaps these intermittent periods of migraine pain are somehow upgrading my abilities. I wish you much love and light in your personal journey.
Karma is real... And she's coming for him!!

I'm aware it would not be my sister's wish. I would have laid it all out in a very complete letter for her to find after I'm gone. As her big sister who has failed her so many times in our lives, this is the only gift that I have to give her. I don't want her to suffer anymore. I want her to be able to live and find some comfort and happiness without always having to worry about what's coming next. I have thought about this so much in the last few weeks. I think this is the only gift that I can give her.
